summary: Read spec, plan, and diff 3ebb6a7...HEAD (src/serve.mjs, test/serve.test.mjs) cold. Ran the suite (all pass) and a 300k-case random fuzz over traversal atoms (.., ., /, %2e/%2E, %2f, %5c, %00, %, %25, %c0%ae, public-secret, ?, #, ;, newline, C:): no throw and no result outside <root>/public. The only fuzz hits were checker false positives for literal names starting with '..' (e.g. public/..., public/..;), and those stay inside public/. No attack proven. Unproven or out-of-scope notes: (1) query/fragment are not stripped, so '/index.html?x=../../a' resolves to public/a: it stays inside public/, and HTTP parsing is out of scope; (2) '/docs/' resolves to the directory public/docs, not null, which AC-1 allows; (3) a non-string root (e.g. undefined) throws from path.resolve, but root is trusted and the never-throw promise covers only requestPath; (4) symlinks inside public/ are not checked with realpath, which is filesystem serving and out of scope; (5) Windows-only behaviour (drive-relative 'C:', NTFS ':' streams, case folding) could not be run on this Linux host, and path.win32 reasoning suggests backslash rejection plus isAbsolute(rel) cover it; (6) categories transactions, concurrency, retries and ordering do not apply because this is a pure synchronous function with no state.
